scripts.sqlc: cd backend && go run github.com/sqlc-dev/sqlc/cmd/sqlc@v1.31.1 generate
scripts.api: npm run api:spec && npm run api:ts
scripts.agents: bash -c 'hook="$HOME/.claude/hooks/polyscribe/polyscribe.sh"; if [ ! -x "$hook" ]; then echo "polyscribe hook not installed; run polypowers-init" >&2; exit 127; fi; exec bash "$hook"'
scripts.agents:system: bash -c 'hook="$HOME/.claude/hooks/polyscribe/polyscribe.sh"; if [ ! -x "$hook" ]; then echo "polyscribe hook not installed; run polypowers-init" >&2; exit 127; fi; exec bash "$hook" --system'
